lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-linear grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a matrix of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal surfaces to shadowed ventral edges.
